ideas.pitch: A BPMN-orchestrated risk diagnosis tool for autonomous agent actions operating on generative AI backends.
ideas.title: AgenticWorkflowAuditor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven high-scoring pattern of combining BPMN orchestration with human-in-the-loop AI governance, matching the winning architecture from UiPath AgentHack.

ideas.pitch: A training-free, self-improving semantic router using kNN over exemplar indices to dynamically route prompts between different LLMs.
ideas.title: SemanticRouterLite
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly implements the highly successful architecture of the Superlinked x Qwen Hackathon winner, demonstrating advanced algorithmic efficiency within a tight 8-hour window.

ideas.pitch: A zero-knowledge gated community portal where human users and autonomous Generative AI agents coexist and verify credentials privately.
ideas.title: ZKAgentGated
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the unique winning formula of Synthesis Hackathon by blending AI agents with ZK privacy circuits, which judges favor for technical ambition.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent marketplace that executes transactions and manages service verification using stablecoin escrow payments.
ideas.title: AutonomousEscrowAgent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Matches the exact blueprint of the Locus Track winner at Synthesis Hackathon, providing a complete functional utility for on-chain AI economies.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight reasoning wrapper that optimises LLM reasoning loops to reduce token consumption and latency during generative tasks.
ideas.title: ReasoningOptimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the OpenAI/Jetbrains hackathon winner by solving a universally felt developer pain point: making LLMs think faster and cheaper.
